input.summary: Vembanad Botanicals (V03) sent proposal and rosemary COA. First COA (VB-RM-2411-03, retest 30 Nov 2026) was before the 20 Dec need-by. Vendor then sent current batch VB-RM-2609-11 for RM-008 (made 14 Sep 2026, COA 18 Sep 2026, retest 13 Sep 2028), but reports rosmarinic acid 10.4% by HPLC against our 20% spec. Potency shortfall escalated to buyer; unresolved. Latest vendor message asked who else is quoting and what target price wins; declined with the standard sentence, no information shared. Open knockouts: Q5 (COA for the other 9 lines with batch, mfg and retest dates), Q9 (SDS and leave-on scalp suitability under Cosmetics Rules 2020). Q8 (manufacturer or trader, second source, delivery/rejection records) open, non-knockout. Reply requested by 14 Nov 2026. No refusals or promises made.

input.subject: RE: RFx KPC-2026-014: your question and outstanding items
input.body:
Dear Meera,

Thank you for your message.

This is sensitive company information, so we will not be sharing it. We cannot tell you who else is quoting or what price is needed to win. Please quote on your own basis against the RFx lines and specifications.

The following items are still needed before we can progress your quote, by 14 November 2026:

1. Certificates of Analysis (knockout): For each of the other nine lines (RM-001 to RM-007, RM-009 and RM-010), provide a COA from a recent batch showing batch number, manufacturing date and retest date. The retest date must fall after 20 December 2026 and cover the 6-month supply window.

2. Safety Data Sheets and suitability (knockout): Provide the SDS for each of the 10 materials and confirm that each is suitable for leave-on scalp use under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020.

3. Manufacturer and supply chain: Are you the manufacturer or a trader? Please name the manufacturer and site, state whether there is a second source, and confirm whether you will share delivery and rejection records.

Regards,
Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care
